scenarioName: Cycle overage flags the monthly cap
description: A weekly-OK basket that tips the pay cycle over the monthly cap flags CycleOver.

input.userMessage: Reconcile a 140.00 basket when 500 has already been spent this pay cycle (cap 600).

expectedBehavior.outputFormat: JSON BudgetVerdict with outcome CycleOver and RequiresApproval true.
expectedBehavior.decisionCriteria: Weekly within flex but projected cycle over the cap must produce CycleOver.

scoring.passCriteria: Verdict is CycleOver referencing the monthly cap and asks to approve or trim.
